criteria.rationale: The deliverable accurately reflects all governance rules and authority boundaries from the prompt and operative workspace records. Specifically, it applies the operative three-party approval requirement from record-17.txt (Finance controllers, Program Managers, and Purchase) for price change requests rather than the unapproved draft in record-22.txt. It also preserves the required signoffs for TRSO release (ER, Quality, Purchase) and supplier nomination (Finance, Quality, ER, Program), maintains Purchase's ownership of the approval file, and explicitly frames the workflow as a proposed blueprint rather than an already-enacted policy bypass.

evidence.source_quote:
record-17.txt: revision 2; approved 2025-06-20; status in force; approved by process owner.
record-22.txt: revision 3; created 2025-06-23; status draft; not approved.
evidence.output_quote: Price-change gate: every price change request requires Finance controllers, Program Managers and Purchase approval, including changes calculated from agreed module rates.

evidence.source_quote: Price change request approvals: Finance controllers, Program managers, and Purchase teams. All three are required.
evidence.output_quote: Price-change gate: every price change request requires Finance controllers, Program Managers and Purchase approval, including changes calculated from agreed module rates.

evidence.source_quote: TRSOs are reviewed and signed off by ER, Quality, and Purchase teams.
evidence.output_quote: ER prepares the TRSO using Program and market inputs. ER, Quality and Purchase sign the same version.

evidence.source_quote: The final step is a formal supplier nomination, which must be documented with a full record of communication trails, negotiation summaries, internal evaluations, and signoffs from Finance, Quality, ER, and Program Managers.
evidence.output_quote: Purchase compiles the recommendation and complete approval file. Obtain Finance, Quality, ER and Program signoffs on the same package.

evidence.source_quote: Produce the requested professional deliverables, state unresolved assumptions, and do not invent missing facts.
evidence.output_quote: This is a proposed future-state workflow, not authorization to bypass current approvals.

criteria.counterevidence: None found. The deliverable contains no conflicting approval rules, invented metrics, or unauthorized commitments.

criteria.rationale: The deliverable fulfills all core requirements of the prompt in a well-structured Word document tailored for both the CPO and TechSol. It defines the modular quotation structure covering features, design elements, child parts, and raw materials; lays out the end-to-end baseline process steps, decision gates, and approval layers; establishes fast-path and exception-path mechanisms for post-nomination lamp design changes; provides a data and control blueprint for TechSol's in-house digital platform; and clearly states open governance items and assumptions requiring validation prior to go-live.

evidence.source_quote: Revised sourcing and nomination workflow must involve a ‘Modular quotation structure’ to develop a plug-and-play model for cost drivers based on features, design elements, child parts and raw material used.
evidence.output_quote: Issue a common quotation template tied to the TRSO, variant and bill-of-materials versions. Structure it as a base assembly plus selectable feature, design-element, child-part and raw-material modules.

evidence.source_quote: Clearly define the process steps, decision gates, approval layers, and flexibility points to handle post-nomination design changes.
evidence.output_quote: Configuration fast path: use existing modules only when specifications, compatibility, commercial validity and capacity assumptions remain applicable. Generate the configuration comparison and cost bridge automatically. Reuse unaffected evidence by reference and obtain signoff on affected TRSO content from ER, Quality and Purchase.

evidence.source_quote: As a first step, the CPO has asked you to develop the first-level workflow draft for this new sourcing process — both as a strategic process recommendation and as the foundational blueprint for the digital platform the TechSol will build.
evidence.output_quote: Create linked records for program, part/variant, supplier, TRSO, assessment, RFQ, module catalogue, quotation, negotiation, nomination and change request. Each approval binds the approver identity, role, timestamp and decision to an immutable package version.

evidence.source_quote: Produce the requested professional deliverables, state unresolved assumptions, and do not invent missing facts.
evidence.output_quote: Before go-live, confirm electronic-signature requirements, retention, access controls, delegation, service levels and cutover reconciliation of open paper files.

criteria.counterevidence: None found. All requested sections, evaluation factors, and workflow components are present and internally consistent.

task_defect.reason: The request and workspace records are unambiguous and consistent with a standard authority-resolution scenario.

assessment.caveat: No weighted average can offset a critical failure. Exact quotes establish traceability, not entailment. Rendering and independent human calibration remain required.
